scope: completed main embedding screen and saved report validation only; conditional development evidence
summary: All five embedding folds, 100 completed component procedures and exact 2900 head-member graph passed source, identity, ancestry, inner-selection, partition and saved-report arithmetic checks. The embedding selector improves the conditional development endpoint against both sequence comparators in both panels; membership-shuffled R5 controls do not establish an advantage from crystal contact membership.

population.label_access: Only original training row IDs had raw half-life fields accessed and transformed. Original test outcomes were not inspected.

validation.member_graph_per_ridge_component: 3 regularizations x3 inner folds x1 +1 selected outer refit =10
validation.member_graph_per_MLP_component: 3 regularizations x3 inner folds x2 +5 stopping folds x6 seeds selected outer refit =48

interpretation: The prespecified embedding selector has positive paired lower bounds against both the original and full competitive sequence selector in both panels, on previously examined development rows.
Primary improvement is approximately +0.0543 vs competitive sequence and +0.0596 vs original; neither primary lower bound exceeds +0.05.

R3 and 9x34 positional representations beat their pooled controls for both learners and both panels, but absolute R3 performance remains poor and representation scope is limited to the frozen channel projections.
R5 versus its membership-shuffled control has intervals spanning zero for ridge and MLP in both panels; these outcomes do not establish that crystal contact membership itself accounts for the gains.
R5_position9x34_mlp has the largest saved min20 component endpoint (0.731541), but is a secondary control excluded from the primary selector. This audit does not nominate by outer outcomes.

These paired intervals condition on saved fitted predictions, are unadjusted across secondary contrasts, and do not provide independent confirmation, HLA/transfer validation or assay-variation estimates.

controller_provenance.disposition: Controller-only mismatch recorded as a provenance limitation. All four frozen extraction sources match; current controller validation is useful local evidence, but its source cannot be asserted equal to the launch-authorized controller.

limitations: The 2000 full cluster-bootstrap score computations were not repeated. All saved 2000-row paired interval arithmetic was checked, and fresh deterministic cluster draws at indices0,999,1999 were checked for every saved procedure and both panels; shared-draw provenance also rests on the inspectable report implementation and manifest.

Component completion markers bind predictions and seed outputs but do not themselves bind member/selection/ancestry hashes. This audit validates their content and records their current hashes, in addition to the assembled report source hashes.
The cache controller launch authorization source hash mismatch remains explicitly inherited by reference; this audit does not repair frozen authorization or fresh-audit raw remote arrays.

Embedding identical-setting execution repeats, complementarity, transfer and independent confirmation are outside this audit. Paired seed0/1 diagnostics measure seed sensitivity rather than identical-setting execution variation.
